scope: LOCAL ONLY initial evolving-source review; not frozen acceptance

findings.issue: Zero-valued explicit version components are accepted as Detect. Actual initializer selects Version::Minor=0 for a valid explicit 5.0 override, allowing foundational profile 5.6 even though the explicit version conflicts.
findings.fix: Represent version Detect with a separate presence boolean or optional values. Preserve explicit minor zero.
findings.required_test: Actual initializer explicit 5.0 must record settings.version REFUSE before seed consume; Detect must accept measured 5.6.

findings.issue: Negative layout tests assert only name substrings and a generic throw caused by unrelated unknown requirements. Offset agreement or presence could become PASS without failing these tests.
findings.fix: Assert exact check name and REFUSE; assert every simultaneous failure status before throw.
findings.required_test: known_offset_conflict, missing_known_member and collect_all must fail if their specific check is mutated to PASS.

findings.issue: Dormant UClass.ClassFlags remains a hardcoded unknown width requirement despite frozen inventory marking its member notqueriedontracedpath. Current generated profile also predates filtering six dormant member requirements.
findings.fix: Regenerate required member pins from required inventory rows; derive unknown widths from required rows only.
findings.required_test: No mandatory profile/layout pin for inventory rows marked notqueriedontracedpath.

findings.issue: New C++ GetStagedNativeLayoutFacts provider was absent from exact consumer/provider checks. Existing role/source gates required fresh native-layoutbinding but did not report the symbol itself.
findings.fix: Check strong U initializer reference and one strong T selected binding/composed definition with no U in composition.
findings.required_test: Final whole-selected artifact receipt includes new_layout_provider evidence.
findings.status: parent reports gate added; final verification pending

findings.issue: Completion shim always increments, including owner_denied, while actual completion refuses when owner disallows. bank_retire=1 is a callback count rather than FD retirement evidence.
findings.fix: Label callback count accurately; retain actual lifecycle/retirement evidence from unchanged bank tests.
findings.required_test: Report does not claim retirement from callback-only extraction.

findings.issue: Copied l18 inputs/source-freeze existed but apply mkdir required a fresh directory, causing failure after units copy and risking partial snapshot.
findings.fix: Parent renamed copied directory inputs/historical-l18-source-freeze and preserved prior files; fresh l19 source-freeze path now absent before binding.
findings.required_test: Fresh source binder completes once and selection provenance uses new l19 freeze.
findings.status: parent corrected owned prep; final binding verification pending

findings.issue: Pin width type/range was unchecked; False, -1 and string8 validated. False generated width0 and disabled the measured field bound comparator.
findings.fix: Require width None or exact positive bounded int; require string provenance fields.
findings.required_test: Malformed pin width bool/negative/string refuses; schema boolean/unsupported version refuses.
findings.status: sent to implementer; final verification pending
